objects.summary: P2 review finds wait IDs are matched by raw substring; C90/XC9/C9x/path/SHA text can accidentally satisfy ATTENTE[C9]. Closure requires an exact delimited reference such as REF[C9] or equivalent whole-token rule.
P2 review finds open_work_in treats GELÉ as open work, generating false Owner alerts when all executable work is finished/blocked/frozen. Frozen reversible work must be non-open.

P2 review finds checksum announcement parsing excludes only recognized candidate markdown blocks; illustrative blocks with documentary SHA-256 text can still be misread as external declarations. All fenced markdown content must be excluded from announcement scanning.
Builder reply confirms GELÉ handling was corrected in bc388adf61 with tests for frozen-only, frozen+READY and misleading status text outside the status cell.
Builder reply confirms wait-ID matching was tightened in bc388adf61 so C90/XC9/C9x/C9-bis no longer close ATTENTE[C9]; exact-token behavior is tested.

cross_object_findings.finding: A watchdog can still suppress legitimate waits after authentication/idempotence fixes if references are substring-matched rather than causally delimited.
A reversible GELÉ lane should not keep the system artificially non-idle or trigger Owner alerts when no executable positive-value work exists.
Integrity metadata should be parsed only from the external declaration surface; content inside any fenced document block is evidence payload, not control syntax.
At least two bounded review findings in this batch have explicit same-lineage fixes and tests, showing that review value was realized rather than merely documented.
